objects.text: Nipah virus: from fruit bats to people, a One Health view
Every icon comes from an open library imported in SiliCoDraw: PhyloPic, NIH BioArt, Arcadia, Servier Medical Art, Reactome, Health Icons, Bioicons and OCHA

Flying foxes carry the virus
without falling ill

Bats contaminate date palm sap;
pigs can pass it on to farmers

The virus enters endothelial cells
and neurons; brain and lungs suffer

Watch bats, animals and people;
test early, isolate, protect carers
